key.name: selected-device-mac
key.description: MAC address of the chosen AirPods device, or empty to auto-detect.

key.name: selected-device-name
key.description: Friendly name of the selected device.

key.name: only-selected-device
key.description: If true, ignore BLE packets from other nearby AirPods.

key.name: rssi-threshold
key.description: Signal strength threshold in dBm. Packets below this strength will not trigger the popup (-100 to -35).

key.name: popup-style
key.description: Visual style and position of the card: 'ios' (bottom-center) or 'macos' (top-right banner).

key.name: popup-duration
key.description: Number of seconds before the animated popup auto-dismisses.

key.name: show-popup-on-open
key.summary: Show popup on case lid open
key.description: Display the animated card when the case is opened nearby.

key.name: show-popup-on-connect
key.description: Display the animated card when AirPods connect to the computer.

key.name: show-panel-indicator
key.description: Display the battery indicator in the GNOME Shell top panel.

key.name: panel-display-mode
key.description: Battery display mode on panel: 'lowest', 'compact', or 'icon'.

key.name: ear-detection-pause
key.description: Pause media when an earbud is removed, and resume when put back in.

key.name: low-battery-notification
key.description: Send system notifications when battery is lower than 20% or 10%.

key.name: trigger-demo
key.description: Counter used to trigger a test popup animation demo from the preferences window and panel menu.
